name: Command Code
tagline: Terminal, desktop, and IDE coding agent for open and frontier models that adapts to your code style.
description: Command Code is an AI coding agent available as a terminal CLI (cmd), a desktop app for macOS, Linux, and Windows, and a VS Code/Cursor extension. It routes requests through its own subscription plans with included model credits or through BYOK providers, including ChatGPT and Copilot subscriptions and local servers, and keeps a local taste profile learned from accepted and rejected edits. It supports plan mode, MCP servers, subagents, git worktrees, Telegram and Discord remote control, and cloud sessions that open draft pull requests.

pricing.notes: Flat monthly plans with included model credits, plus a processing fee; extra credits are billed at model cost with no markup. No free plan. BYOK, ChatGPT/Copilot subscriptions, and local servers also work.
